integrity: The universal statement is proved by an exhaustive symbolic classification of monotone maps, an isolation criterion, an explicit order-preserving retraction on the unique nonisolated component, and a relative simplicial-contiguity argument. The packaged enumerator checks representative small instances without extrapolating from them.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes p,q,r,s are all at least 2 and treats complete height-two finite T0-spaces.
The strong deformation retraction is asserted for the order complex of the nonisolated map-space component, not as a beat-point retraction of the finite map poset itself.
Finite enumeration is supplementary; the universal claim rests on the symbolic map classification and simplicial contiguity argument.
Targeted searches cannot exclude an unindexed or differently phrased earlier special-family computation.
title: Mapping-space decomposition for complete height-two finite models
